name: copilotprompts-skill-photo-booth
title: Photo Booth Skill for Microsoft 365 Copilot
shortDescription: Create a photorealistic 3x3 photo-booth grid from reference images with strict visual continuity.
longDescription: This skill creates a synchronized 3x3 photo-booth grid from reference images while preserving the subjects, wardrobe, environment, lighting, framing, and photographic treatment. Package SKILL.md at the root of a ZIP archive and upload it to a Declarative Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder. Custom skills are currently available in preview through the Microsoft Frontier Program, with general availability planned soon.
